defects.name: channels computed BEFORE its d0 input exists (swallowed)

the chain is defined at line 1374 WITHOUT a d0 parameter; d0 is only assigned at line 1437
=> Python raises UnboundLocalError BEFORE the DRC exists; the except at line 1416 swallows it
=> the maze at line 1442 receives --channels <empty> (proven: k2_reroute_router_floor_v1 --channels default '')
the run's own chain records it verbatim: {stage: channels_compute_failed, err: UnboundLocalError}
defects.fix_named: compute the channels AFTER d0 is written (i.e. between regen.py:1438 and the maze call at 1441); keep the fallback chain channels_arg_by_block(...) or channels_arg(...); make a total failure FAIL-LOUD.

defects.name: channels_arg_by_block returns '' on its own input (design defect, not just infeasible input)
evidence: multi_block_plan verdict INFEASIBLE: named CONTROL 'does not fit in the region (area/height)'
its 'sizes' come from the DRC ENDPOINT spread (POWER 28.37 x 35.90mm) - i.e. the whole board, not a block
defects.fix_named: size blocks by their MEMBER/device extent (pad bbox), not by the union of DRC endpoint coordinates.

defects.name: functional_blocks family predicate is degenerate (per-member, first-match over the union of its nets)
evidence: FB.functional_blocks(members, netof) with netof = the real board net map collapses 15/25 members (U1,U2,U4,L1,R1,R40,E2,J12,J13,C84,C85,C86,C88,C90,D2) into POWER because each touches >=1 power net
with the CORRECT per-NET predicate: 4 blocks whose pad bboxes OVERLAP and whose summed area (2403mm^2) > the frame area (1286mm^2) => a disjoint multi-block plan is INFEASIBLE on this frame
defects.fix_named: block = net-set partition by family_of(net) EXCLUDING plane nets; a member may belong to >1 block; the plan must be a per-NET channel assignment, not a disjoint rectangle pack.
